Run the complete multi-omics survival analysis pipeline

Source: R/run_Omics2Surv.R
run_Omics2Surv.Rd

Single-call wrapper that orchestrates the full workflow: optional data retrieval from LinkedOmics, optional train/test split, per-omic feature screening, MAE construction, model training (and prediction when a test set exists), benchmarking, and downstream analyses (stratification, Kaplan-Meier, feature heatmap, enrichment) on the best model.

Usage

run_Omics2Surv(
  omics_list = NULL,
  clinical_data = NULL,
  cancer_type = NULL,
  linkedomics_omics = NULL,
  screening_specs,
  model_specs,
  train_fraction = 0.7,
  seed = 4820,
  best_by = c("uno_test", "harrell_test"),
  do_benchmark = TRUE,
  do_stratification = TRUE,
  strat_method = c("median", "survcutpoint", "user"),
  strat_threshold = NULL,
  do_km = TRUE,
  do_heatmap = TRUE,
  heatmap_annotations = NULL,
  do_enrichment = FALSE,
  enrichment_params = list(),
  aftcoop_rho = NULL,
  dataset_name = "Dataset",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

omics_list

Named list of raw omics matrices (features x samples), or NULL when using the LinkedOmics download mode. Names become assay names in the MAE (e.g. list(mRNA = ..., CNV = ...)).

clinical_data

Matrix/data frame of clinical data (variables x samples), or NULL in LinkedOmics mode. Must contain rows "overall_survival" and "status".

cancer_type

Character. TCGA cancer-type string for LinkedOmics download (e.g. "TCGA-LGG"). Ignored when omics_list is supplied. Default NULL.

linkedomics_omics

Named list mapping the assay names you want to the LinkedOmics data-type strings (e.g. list(mRNA = "RNASeq (HiSeq, Gene Level)")). Required in LinkedOmics mode. Default NULL.

screening_specs

Named list (same names as omics_list / linkedomics_omics). Each element is a list describing how to screen that omic. See Details.

model_specs

List of model requests. See Details.

train_fraction

Numeric in (0, 1) for the train/test split, or NULL to skip splitting and train on the entire dataset. When NULL, no test set is built, no predictions are made, and best_by is forced to "harrell_train". Default 0.7.

seed

Integer seed for the split and cross-validation. Default 4820.

best_by

Character. Metric used to pick the best model: "uno_test" or "harrell_test" when a test set exists; automatically forced to "harrell_train" when train_fraction = NULL. Default "uno_test".

do_benchmark

Logical. Build the benchmarking table? Default TRUE.

do_stratification

Logical. Run patient stratification on the best model? Default TRUE.

strat_method

Stratification cutpoint method: "median", "survcutpoint", or "user". Default "median".

strat_threshold

Numeric threshold for strat_method = "user". Default NULL.

do_km

Logical. Draw Kaplan-Meier curves? Requires do_stratification = TRUE. Default TRUE.

do_heatmap

Logical. Draw feature heatmap? Requires do_stratification = TRUE. Skipped automatically for late-integration ensembles. Default TRUE.

heatmap_annotations

Character vector of colData column names to add as annotation tracks in the heatmap. Default NULL.

do_enrichment

Logical. Run pathway enrichment on the best model's features? Skipped for late-integration ensembles. Default FALSE.

enrichment_params

Named list of extra arguments forwarded to enrich_features. Default list().

aftcoop_rho

Numeric or NULL. For AFTCoop models: selects the beta_rho_<rho> variant in benchmark, heatmap, stratification, feature heatmap and enrichment. Auto-resolves when only one rho was trained; errors clearly when multiple are present. Default NULL.

dataset_name

Character label used in c_heatmap. Default "Dataset".

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages? Default TRUE.

Value

A named list with:

  • mae_train: MAE with all fitted models in its metadata.

  • mae_test: MAE with predictions in its metadata, or NULL when train_fraction = NULL.

  • benchmark: data frame from benchmark_models, or NULL.

  • best_model: named list with model, modality, integration, metric, and value.

  • stratification: output of patient_stratification, or NULL.

  • km_plot: ggsurvplot object, or NULL.

  • heatmap: pheatmap object, or NULL.

  • c_index_heatmap: ggplot from c_heatmap, or NULL.

  • enrichment: output of enrich_features, or NULL.

Details

screening_specs

Each element must have a type field ("RNA", "methyl", or "CNV") and typically a method field ("supervised", "unsupervised", "biological", or NULL). All other fields are forwarded to prepare_RNA() / prepare_methyl() / prepare_CNV(); unrecognised fields are ignored (with a message), so a shared template can be reused across omics.

model_specs

Each element is a list with type ("pen_reg", "joint", or "flexynesis"), omic_list (assay names to use), and type-specific fields (model_method/integration/late_method for pen_reg; joint_method for joint). Extra arguments go in a params sub-list forwarded to the underlying train function.

No-split mode (train_fraction = NULL)

The entire dataset is used for training. No test MAE is built, no predictions are computed, and best_by is forced to "harrell_train". Downstream steps (stratification, KM, heatmap) run on mae_train itself.

Data input

Supply data in one of two ways:

  • User-supplied matrices (default): pass omics_list and clinical_data directly. Any LinkedOmics-like matrices work here - from retrieve_linkedomics_data, prepare_custom_data, or any other source.

  • LinkedOmics download: pass cancer_type and linkedomics_omics instead. The function calls retrieve_linkedomics_data automatically, so omics_list and clinical_data must be NULL.
